source_review_finding: Initial os.path.abspath collapsed parent components before symlink traversal, so ambiguous symlink-plus-parent paths could describe different header bytes. Initial passing52mock tests and3saveddepfiles did not establish correctness for that case.
resolution: Final capability rejects any parent component in dependency tokens and symlink targets before normalization; real saved3depfiles need no such components. Separate negatives enforce bounds. No general filesystem resolver claimed.
